item.description: Join now opens the actual meeting link. Invites often contain several links to the same provider — Microsoft Teams ones in particular carry "Meeting options", dial-in, channel and app links alongside the real one — and Heads Up could pick whichever appeared first in the invite instead of the link that actually joins the meeting. It now works out which one is the join link. The same applies to Zoom and Webex invites that include download or dial-in links.

The full-screen alert can no longer get stuck. Press Esc to dismiss it, or Return to join when there's a single meeting to join.
Connecting or disconnecting a display while an alert is up now works properly too — the alert redraws itself for the displays you actually have. Previously, unplugging a screen could leave the alert stranded with its buttons off-screen, and because it covers the menu bar there was no way to close it short of force-quitting.
The tray menu now also shows which version you're running, just above Check for Updates.

Double-booked or back-to-back meetings that start at the same time now show up as a single full-screen alert listing all of them, each with its own Join button, instead of one alert silently replacing another before you could see it.
